description: Seq 3 revokes H2 and loosens a policy field (control rule), so it is not removal-only: final at seq 5, it revokes H2 without excusing it. Seq 4 adds a key (witnesses H1 and H2, still provisional); seq 6 adds another (witness H1 only); seq 7 revokes H1 by recovery and is final at once, excusing H1. Every witness of seq 6 is excused, but seq 4 is an earlier provisional addition, so Order keeps seq 6 provisional too.
